title: Stock nrf_fuel_gauge ARM harness (Unicorn + MVE/DLS hooks) runs with real EVENBAT; C body not yet replaced
scope: Host Unicorn only. No hardware flash. No commit. Source-only estimate was not replaced because the reconstructed C body is not yet verified.

stock_library.note: Newer than the in-tree Nordic 1.0.1 Cortex-M4 hard-float archive. Stock is IAR Cortex-M55 and uses MVE plus Armv8.1-M low-overhead loops.

harness.engine: Unicorn 2.1.4, UC_MODE_THUMB|MCLASS, CPU model Cortex-M7 (no native MVE/DLS)
harness.method: Map stock.app.bin at 0x00438000 and SRAM at 0x20000000. Patch 155 MVE sites, 16 DLS/LE sites, and the isfinite vcvt.f64.f32/vmov pair to NOP, then hook CODE to emulate them. EVENBAT is the table already in the stock image.

mutant_evenbat_param9_doubled.note: SOC at this first rest sample was unchanged; r0 in the state info doubled, so the harness is sensitive to the real table.

not_done: Did not decompile the process core (0x43A698, 0x43A1B0 and callees) into verified C
Did not re-run paired Renode sims (no image change)
TTF-after-charge was still NaN in the short VBUS+CC sample; term-current ext_state was not applied in that probe
next: Translate the stock bodies to C from the objdump/Ghidra already collected, compile the C as Thumb hard-float, and compare it to this Unicorn stock golden on random inputs, the EVENBAT tables, and planted mutants. Replace the source-only estimate only after that match.
